items.prompt: Why use a vector for this synthetic event sequence with repeated labels?

options.text: It guarantees that each label occurs only once
options.why: A vector preserves duplicate records; uniqueness requires an additional explicit policy.

options.text: Every repeated label is safely discarded
options.why: That would change the input multiplicity.

options.text: All operations are worst-case constant time
options.why: Middle modifications and algorithms have other costs.

options.text: It preserves the sequence and repeated records
options.why: Duplicate meaning still needs a separate event policy.

items.explanation: A unique-key map can silently collapse labels if used as a replay log without an explicit duplicate contract.
